description: This file implements a CalendarHandler class and a CalendarDataSource interface for managing calendar events on Android using the CalendarContract API. It includes data classes for requests and records, permission checks, event retrieval, and addition functionalities, along with JSON parsing and validation logic.

classes.name: CalendarHandler
classes.description: Main class handling calendar event operations including retrieving and adding events, with permission checks and JSON request parsing.

classes.name: CalendarDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for interacting with calendar data such as permission checks, fetching events, and adding new events.

classes.name: CalendarEventsRequest
classes.description: Data class representing request parameters for fetching calendar events.

classes.name: CalendarAddRequest
classes.description: Data class representing request parameters for adding a new calendar event.

classes.name: CalendarEventRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event record with details like identifier, title, start and end times, location, and calendar name.

methods.name: handleCalendarEvents
methods.description: Handles fetching calendar events based on JSON request, returns JSON with events or error.

methods.name: handleCalendarAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a calendar event based on JSON request, returns added event or error.

methods.name: parseEventsRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into CalendarEventsRequest object, with default values if absent.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into CalendarAddRequest object, validating and extracting fields.

methods.name: parseISO
methods.description: Parses ISO date string into Instant object, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: eventJson
methods.description: Serializes a CalendarEventRecord into JSON object.
